761930101.text: Whoa! A real Melusine! Aww... such a tiny, adorable little Melusine...

761930103.text: Umm... may I... touch you? I've always wondered what a Melusine like you feels like...

761930104.text: Something so cute and so clever... Are you smooth? Or soft? Or maybe fluffy? Hehe... don't be scared. I just want to give you a little...

761930106.text: Please mind your conduct, miss, and refrain from any actions that may violate the statutes.

761930107.text: Miss Mamere is a citizen of Fontaine. Unauthorized physical contact may lead to misunderstandings and could carry serious legal consequences, including imprisonment for over three years and permanent prohibition from entry.

761930108.text: Aaaah! A machine that moves and talks...!

761930109.text: Ahem... my apologies. She was just too adorable, and I got carried away...

761930110.text: My name's Linnea. I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild. Uh... And I promise I'm not a weirdo!

761930111.text: Negative. Individuals engaging in suspicious behavior often insist they are "not a weirdo." This is a basic principle of deductive reasoning, Miss Linnea.

761930113.text: You shouldn't just go around calling people weirdos, Seymour.

761930114.text: This small fairy lady has really pretty colors. She's not like Fa{RUBY#[D]Elynas}ther, but she feels warm and looks nice. That means she's not a weirdo.

761930115.text: Negative. With the exception of purple, coloration generally bears no relation to one's moral alignment. This is a basic principle of deductive reasoning, Miss Mamere.

761930116.text: ...I wasn't talking about the color of people's clothes, Seymour.

761930117.text: Huh? Why is purple an exception?

761930118.text: Well... hello, Linnea. My name is Mamere. I'm a traveling painter from Fontaine. This is Seymour. He's a good friend of mine.

761930119.text: I didn't expect to meet anyone else here. Are you here to gather inspiration, too?

761930120.text: Gather inspiration... hmm, let me think. I suppose adding new entries to my archive counts, right?

761930121.text: Linnea tells Mamere about the pink Frostfin Whale...

761930122.text: And, hehe... maybe Maisie was right after all. That Frostfin Whale really does bring good luck! I even got to meet an adorable Melusine—

761930123.text: Please mind your conduct, miss, and refrain from any actions that may violate the statutes.

761930124.text: I—I know! I won't touch anything without permission!

761930125.text: I see. Do you like animals, Linnea?

761930126.text: Absolutely! *sigh*... if only I could swim as fast as a Melusine... Those Frostfin Whales looked like they were having so much fun. I want to play with them too...

761930127.text: Hmm... then I'll give this painting to you, Linnea.

761930128.text: It can't help you swim faster, but if you hang it in your room... maybe it'll feel like you're playing with the Frostfin Whales.

761930129.text: Whoa... thank you! It's beautiful! When I get back, I'll show it to everyone in Speranza for sure!
